description: Source file implementing WiFi management and IARM communication for NetworkManager Gnome MfrMgr, including functions to retrieve WiFi details via D-Bus, save and clear WiFi credentials using IARM, and manage IARM connection state.

classes.name: NetworkManagerMfrManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing WiFi credentials and IARM communication for NetworkManager Gnome MfrMgr.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerMfrManager.

methods.name: saveWiFiSettingsToMfr
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves current WiFi details and saves them to Mfr via background thread.

methods.name: saveWiFiSettingsToMfrSync
methods.description: Synchronously saves WiFi credentials to Mfr using IARM, with verification.

methods.name: clearWiFiSettingsFromMfr
methods.description: Clears WiFi credentials from Mfr via IARM.
